POC asks / acceptance criteria:

requirements_summary: Scale: catalog ~200M SKU variants (target index 100M dense vectors for POC). Latency: end-to-end retrieval+rerank 95th pct <180ms. Throughput: sustained 300 QPS baseline, burst 2k QPS for seasonal peaks. Cost target: <= $0.003 per query (embeddings + reranking amortized). Model preferences: open LLM reranker (quantized 8-bit) + fast embedding model; prefer routing to cheaper variant on low-value queries. Security/compliance: enterprise SSO (SAML), audit logs, KMS for keys, able to keep EU/NA residency for subsets. Integration needs: Elastic as primary store, Redwood for vector store + reranker, streaming index pipeline for daily catalog diffs.
